pages.text: $(l)Coke oven$()$(li)$(item)CO2 tank full: pump it out from the TOP face$(): the CO2 by-product only leaves through the top of the oven. A pipe on a side will never drain it.$(li)$(item)Creosote tank full: pump it out from a side$().
Either full tank $(item)pauses the whole oven$(). Send the CO2 to an Exhaust or a smokestack, and keep the creosote for simple engines or the blast stove.

$(l)Firebox$()$(li)$(item)Not enough fuel to burn$(): the tank holds less than one burn's worth. Pipe more fuel in.$(li)$(item)This fluid is not a firebox fuel$(): fireboxes burn LPG, butane, propane, hydrogen, diesel, kerosene and naphtha. Empty the tank and change the fluid.$(li)$(item)Exhaust full: pump the CO2 away$(): like engines, a firebox stops when its CO2 has nowhere to go.
A cold firebox means a cold vat or distillation tower above it, so check the firebox first when one of those slows down.
